records.title: C2FO and Ripple Partner to Modernize Trade Finance Using the XRP Ledger
records.summary: C2FO's own Oct. 27 release reports that existing C2FO Early Pay programs have helped businesses access more than $525B in working capital. It separately describes C2FO Instant Pay as an initiative using XRPL and RLUSD for settlement, funded by participating capital providers, with interested businesses directed to a waitlist. Ripple's parallel Oct. 27 release reports more than $520B for the existing Early Pay programs.
records.limitations: The $525B figure is historical company-reported Early Pay activity, not Instant Pay production volume, XRPL settlement value, XRP demand or new capital deployed by this initiative. The parallel Ripple release says $520B; preserve the publisher-specific discrepancy. No funded invoice count, settled value, named capital providers or production transaction IDs are disclosed.
